result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The most obvious problem is a raw localization key being shown as a section title. There is also some right-edge clipping in horizontally scrolling content that may look unfinished if not intentional.

issues.description: The section title displays the raw translation key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing label.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization lookup for this string and replace it with the intended title, such as "Popular near you" or the appropriate translated text.

issues.description: Some horizontal content is visibly cut off at the right edge, including the category chips and the third restaurant card in the "Fastest near you" row. If this is meant to be a carousel, the partial clipping looks a bit abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel spacing, snapping, or a fade/peek treatment so the partial items look intentional, and ensure the row has consistent horizontal padding.
